arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Draw one smooth 2D cartoon game prop. A long extremely thin fishing rod segment diagonal UPPER LEFT to LOWER RIGHT. Thicker reddish-brown base at upper left, tapering to black hairline tip at lower right, where bend steepens downward. Exact first-source angular direction and smooth underlying curve; do not mirror or flatten. No visible reel or separatehandle, no invented eyelets/line/hook. FIRST original image governs geometry, orientation and included parts; second image ONLY matching warm-brown wood, subtle amber light, silver metal, clean dark outline and restrained cel shading. Do not inherit second image's pose or extra mechanical parts. Redraw pixel steps as clean continuous curves, not pixel art. Preserve extremely slender relative thickness, do not turn it into a branch. True transparent alpha PNG; no scenery/floor/shadows/glow/text. Entire shape inside canvas with 5% margin.
